$comment: Room packs to create on Lemon Squeezy (Store → Products → New product), in Test mode and in Live mode. Each is a single payment. The product name must contain 'Pack' and the pack's keyword (shared/roomPacks.ts lemonMatch) so the site finds it. Prices must match shared/roomPacks.ts.

products.name: Valentine Room Pack
products.description: Six animated 3D items for your Perlink room: a rose arch, rose bouquet, heart balloons, candle heart, beating neon heart and a teddy bear.

products.name: Wedding Room Pack
products.description: Six animated 3D items for your Perlink room: a wedding arch with veils, turning cake, pouring champagne tower, LOVE lights, lanterns and sparklers.

products.name: Birthday Room Pack
products.description: Six animated 3D items for your Perlink room: a birthday cake with candles, balloons, a popping gift tower, disco light show, confetti cannons and bunting.

products.name: Galaxy Room Pack
products.description: Six animated 3D items for your Perlink room: a floating planet with moons, jellyfish lamp, star projector, moon lamp, snow globe and nebula painting.

products.name: Tet Room Pack
products.description: Six animated 3D items for your Perlink room: peach and apricot blossom trees with wish cards, a kumquat tree, red lanterns, firecrackers and fruit tray.

products.name: Proposal Room Pack
products.description: Six animated 3D items for your Perlink room: an opening ring box, MARRY ME lights, a 99-rose heart, petal aisle, self-playing piano and fireworks.

products.name: Showroom Room Pack
products.description: Six animated 3D items that turn your Perlink room into your own shop: a glass cabinet and promo screen showing your real products (visitors click to order), a neon sign and sale banner with your own words, a turning product podium and a till.
